hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; PY="$ROOT/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || exit 0; "$PY" -m code_review_graph update --skip-flows --repo "$ROOT" || true

cat >/dev/null || true; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; PY="$ROOT/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || exit 0; "$PY" -m code_review_graph status --repo "$ROOT" || echo 'code-review-graph: status failed (graph may need a rebuild)'
